description: The City of Calgary publishes a point inventory of its fire-station locations. The metadata lists station number, name, address, community, point geometry and modification date. Additional fields relate the points to city quadrants and ward boundaries, including a historical ward layer. The station points provide emergency-service facility locations for response-area and accessibility simulation when combined with a suitable road network. They do not establish crew availability, vehicle counts, dispatch rules or response times. The metadata does not state a historical coverage period or positional accuracy. A recent portal update date describes the dataset update and does not establish that every listed station was physically inspected on that date. The public portal and JSON catalogue metadata are free to access. The licence is See Terms of Use. Legacy CSV export checks returned HTTP 410; current distribution access remains unverified. No dataset rows were downloaded. Related records include the parent open-data catalogue for Calgary.
